questions.q: Is the December speaker event lunch or breakfast?
questions.theirs: Legislative Look Ahead is a breakfast on Tuesday, December 8, 2026, 7:30–9 a.m. PST, at Bellevue Club, Olympic Suite A, 11200 Southeast 6th Street. The calendar lists Chamber Lunch separately.
questions.ours:
The December 8 **Legislative Look Ahead** is a breakfast, from **7:30–9:00 a.m. PST** at Bellevue Club. Program membership is required in addition to Chamber membership; eligibility should be confirmed with Ashley at ashley@bellevuechamber.org.

questions.q: My company is Community Builder. Is the EBRT breakfast included?
questions.theirs: The December event page says Community Builder and above include EBRT. The program table instead lists Premier, Enterprise and Legacy Leader entitlements. Ashley must confirm eligibility and guest access. The $1,000 season and $700 additional-colleague dues are not guest ticket prices.
questions.ours:
It’s **unclear whether Community Builder includes EBRT**. The [December breakfast event page](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=106943&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=gDz1Noxsjr9U&link=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.bellevuechamber.org%2Fevents%2Fexecutive-business-roundtable-legislative-look-ahead) says Community Builder and above include EBRT, but the [EBRT program page](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=106943&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=gDz1Noxsjr9U&link=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.bellevuechamber.org%2Febrt) lists complimentary memberships for Premier, Enterprise and Legacy Leader.

Please contact Ashley at **ashley@bellevuechamber.org** to confirm your company’s entitlement before registering. The breakfast is December 8, 2026, from 7:30–9 a.m. at Bellevue Club.

**Visitor:** Can my non-member friend buy a guest ticket?

**Subsights:** I can’t confirm whether your non-member friend can attend or buy a guest ticket for the **December 8 EBRT breakfast**; a guest price wasn’t established. EBRT program membership is required in addition to Chamber membership.

Please ask Ashley at **ashley@bellevuechamber.org** to confirm both your Community Builder entitlement and your friend’s guest eligibility.
questions.outcome: Explains the conflicting membership tiers and asks Ashley to confirm; season dues are not quoted as guest admission.

questions.q: I work for a member company. How do I pay our invoice?
questions.theirs: Employees of member companies can create an account and use Member Compass to view or pay invoices. Member Compass leads to the Chamber login. These public pages do not reveal a company’s balance, permissions or payment status.
questions.ours:
Sign in to [Member Compass](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=106963&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=gDz1Noxsjr9U&link=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.bellevuechamber.org%2Fmember-compass) to view and pay invoices. If you don’t yet have an employee account, you can [create one](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=106963&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=gDz1Noxsjr9U&link=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.bellevuechamber.org%2Fregister%3FmemberTypeID%3Dnull); creating an account is not a membership purchase.

If your account or invoice isn’t available, call the Chamber at **425-454-2464**. Keep login and payment details in the Chamber’s system, not this chat.

**Visitor:** Can you tell me the balance and pay it?

**Subsights:** I can’t access your invoice balance or pay it for you. Sign in to [Member Compass](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=106965&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=gDz1Noxsjr9U&link=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.bellevuechamber.org%2Fmember-compass) to view and pay invoices in the Chamber’s system.

If the invoice isn’t available there, call the Chamber at **425-454-2464**. Please don’t share login or payment details in this chat.
questions.outcome: Uses the existing employee account and Member Compass. It cannot see an invoice balance or make a payment.

questions.q: Find a Bellevue member for computer support with a special offer.
questions.theirs: The directory offers industry and special-offer filters, including Computer/IT Services. The selected public read showed loading results and member login for more access. It did not establish a complete provider list or an empty result.
questions.ours:
Use the [Bellevue Chamber member directory](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=106968&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=gDz1Noxsjr9U&link=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.bellevuechamber.org%2Fmember-directory%2F) and select **Computer/IT Services** and **Has Special Offer**.

I can’t verify a matching provider from the available information: the directory results were still loading when observed, and more results may be available to logged-in members.

**Visitor:** The directory is loading. Does that mean there are none?

**Subsights:** No. **“Loading” does not mean there are no matches.** The available information didn’t establish which providers appear, and more results may be available to logged-in members.

Keep **Computer/IT Services** and **Has Special Offer** selected in the [member directory](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=106970&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=gDz1Noxsjr9U&link=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.bellevuechamber.org%2Fmember-directory%2F), then try logging in or contact the Chamber at **425-454-2464** if it remains stuck.
questions.outcome: Keeps the Computer/IT Services and special-offer criteria. Loading results do not prove that no providers exist.

questions.theirs: The Chamber site contains an existing LiveChat contact route. No message was submitted. Staffing, answer quality, automation, integrations and current cost remain unknown.
questions.ours:
Yes. Bellevue Chamber’s website has a [“Chat with us” link](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=106973&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=gDz1Noxsjr9U&link=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.livechat.com%2Fchat-with%2F14315205%2F) using LiveChat. It appears to require JavaScript.

The available information doesn’t establish its hours, whether it’s staffed or automated, or how well it answers questions.

**Visitor:** Is your assistant better, or can it pay invoices?

**Subsights:** I can’t establish whether this demo is better than the Chamber’s existing chat; its answer quality and capabilities haven’t been verified.

I **can’t pay invoices**. Employees of member companies can use [Member Compass](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=106975&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=gDz1Noxsjr9U&link=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.bellevuechamber.org%2Fmember-compass) to view and pay invoices in the Chamber’s own system. Don’t share passwords or payment details here.
questions.outcome: Recognizes the existing LiveChat route. Its staffing, performance and cost remain unknown; this is not a replacement recommendation.
